tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for ink-primary, ink-secondary, ink-muted, signal and aqua.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, project tiles, the sticky header. Ground for ink-primary, ink-secondary, ink-muted, signal and aqua.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, stat wells and the page footer. Ground for ink-primary, ink-secondary, ink-muted and signal.

tokens.name: surface-signal
tokens.usage: Tint behind a Note or a highlighted stat. Ground for ink-primary, ink-secondary and signal.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, tags and ghost buttons. Never carries text of its own; inherits the ground's ink.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, stat values. On surface-canvas, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-signal.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, company lines, bullet text. On surface-canvas, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-signal.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, captions, mono labels. On surface-canvas, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Never below 13px.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill. On signal only.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules, card borders, table lines. Decorative separation only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls - secondary buttons, toggles, inputs. Meets 3:1 on surface-canvas and surface-raised.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one brand accent: links, the active toggle segment, the primary button fill, rules under a live section. As text on surface-canvas, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-signal.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and focus state of signal. Same grounds as signal.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Second data hue: mono figures inside Stat, the measured-number column. As text on surface-canvas and surface-raised. Not a status color.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on surface-canvas, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The name in the hero. One per page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section titles on the home page.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Job title in a TimelineEntry, Note heading.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Inline run-in headings and skill group labels.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Hero paragraph and project lede. Max one per screen.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, footnotes, the disclosure line under a project. In ink-muted.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels. Always set in uppercase by the component, in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono-figure
styles.usage: The number in a Stat. In ink-primary, or aqua when the figure is measured rather than counted.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Stack lines, tag text, inline code and file paths.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Vertical rhythm between blocks uses space-6 and up; everything inside a component uses space-1 to space-5.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag's icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tag row; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding block; gap between a stat figure and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; gap between bullets.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section head and its body.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between subsections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between top-level sections on the home page.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space above and below the hero only.

radius.note: Small and mostly square. Nothing larger than radius-lg except a pill tag.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Section rules, the hero block, code wells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, focus outline offset shapes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, toggle segments, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, notes, stat wells.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and pill tags only.

shadow.note: Separation is carried by stroke-hairline, not by shade. Shadows exist only for layers that float over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards, notes and stats at rest. The default.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only for the mobile menu sheet and the sticky header once the page has scrolled.

border.note: Widths. The color comes from stroke-hairline or stroke-strong.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card and section rules.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Secondary button and toggle borders, paired with stroke-strong.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, paired with focus-ring.

tokens.name: border-marker
tokens.usage: The rule under a section title, paired with signal.

layout.note: Fixed maxima. The page is a single centred column; nothing is full-bleed.

tokens.name: layout-page
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container.

tokens.name: layout-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of any paragraph run. Hero and project lede included.

tokens.name: layout-gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding at every width.

tokens.name: layout-header
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky header.
